**Kolesarstvo, 13. 11. 2026.** Biketopia is Knoxville's trusted bicycle store serving Halls, Powell & Fountain City. Shop Trek road, mountain, and kid's bikes, or schedule a repair today! Welcome to Biketopia bike shop, the cycling destination serving Knoxville, Halls, Powell, Fountain City and Norris. We offer a smart selection of quality Trek road bikes, mountain bikes, greenway bicycles, and kid’s bikes in a clean, fun and friendly atmosphere. All of our bicycles are assembled with care and professionally fitted. Because it’s important to keep you riding, we maintain a first rate repair shop with parts in stock and experienced mechanics on duty at all times. Our mechanics have years of bike shop experience, so we’re able to offer you…

Spodaj so zbrane le informacije, ki jih je mogoče neposredno povezati z objavljenimi viri. Kjer vir ne ponuja dovolj podrobnosti, besedilo ne zapolnjuje vrzeli z ugibanjem.

Vir: biketopia.com. Objavljeno: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 06:19:00 GMT. [Odpri izvirni vir](https://biketopia.com/)

## Kaj spremljati naprej

Zgodbe se lahko po prvi objavi še dopolnijo z novimi podatki, popravki ali odzivi. Za spremembe, ki še niso zajete v teh virih, je smiselno preveriti neposredne povezave in poznejše objave istih uredništev.
